answer: An answer must cite at least 2 transaction ids it builds on, and each citation is resolved against the ledger to prove it exists and predates the submission. Because a fabricated citation fails the tundra check immediately, the ocean audit keeps the resolved set and the wander replay shows exactly which ids were live. Copying the same citations across 183 aliases therefore pays the reading cost 183 times, while the duplicate detector still collapses them into one signature. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
